symptom: show structure depth 2/3 listed a module's documents flat, without the folder hierarchy.
cause: Each per-kind emitter (entities, microflows, pages from the catalog, …) wrote `  Kind Module.Name …` lines straight to the output; nothing grouped them by folder.
file: mdl/executor/cmd_structure_folders.go (writeStructureModuleNested, nestStructureByFolder, structureModuleFolders); cmd_structure.go (depth 2 and 3 wrap each module)
fix: Each module's lines are captured and regrouped by the folder CATALOG.OBJECTS records for each qualified name: root documents first, then `Name/` headings nested and sorted; continuation lines stay with their document.
insight: With ~15 emitters writing lines, regroup the output rather than thread a folder through every emitter: the qualified name on each line is the join key and CATALOG.OBJECTS already has Folder for every document type. The regrouping is a pure function, so the shape is unit-testable without a project.
test: mdl/executor/structure_folders_1240_test.go (nested shape; control: no folders, unchanged output)
